title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يؤم المصلين على جنازة فضيلة الإمام الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي - رحمه الله تعالى
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Leads the Funeral Prayer for His Eminence Imam Sheikh Yusuf al-Qaradawi — May God Almighty Have Mercy on Him
body_ar:
أمَّ مساء اليوم 27 سبتمبر 2022م فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء جموع المصلين على جنازة فضيلة الإمام الشيخ يوسف بن عبدالله القرضاوي في جامع الإمام محمد بن عبد الوهاب في العاصمة القطرية الدوحة.
وقد حضر الصلاة جمع غفير من طلاب الإمام ومحبيه هذا بالإضافة إلى عدد كبير من العلماء والمفكرين و قادة الحركات الإسلامية

ويعتبر الشيخ الددو العلامة القرضاوي - رحمه الله تعالى – من الذين من الله عليهم بالتمسك بهذا الدين والدفاع عنه ويكفيه أنه "ما توفاه الله حتى انفرد بالإمامة، فلم يكن في عصره أكبر منه حظا من ميراث رسول الله عليه وسلم، فكان الوارث الأول لرسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم في هذا الزمان".
وتوفي فضيلة الإمام يوسف القرضاوي زوال الاثنين26 سبتمبر 2022 عن 96 سنة، أمضاها في الدعوة والتعليم والتأليف ونصرة المظلومين والدفاع عن الشعائر والمقدسات
body_en:
This evening, 27 September 2022, His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, head of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, led the assembled worshippers in the funeral prayer for His Eminence Imam Sheikh Yusuf ibn Abdullah al-Qaradawi, at the Imam Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab congregational mosque in the Qatari capital, Doha.
A great throng of the Imam's students and of those who loved him attended the prayer, as well as a large number of scholars, thinkers and leaders of Islamic movements.

Sheikh al-Dedew reckons the learned scholar al-Qaradawi — may God Almighty have mercy on him — among those whom God favoured with holding fast to this religion and defending it; and it is enough for him that "God did not take him until he stood alone in the imamate: there was no one in his age with a greater share of the inheritance of the Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, and so he was the foremost inheritor of the Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, in this time of ours".
His Eminence Imam Yusuf al-Qaradawi died at midday on Monday 26 September 2022, aged 96, which he spent in calling people to Islam, in teaching, in writing, in coming to the aid of the wronged, and in defending the rites and the sanctuaries of Islam.

flags.arabic: ما توفاه الله حتى انفرد بالإمامة
flags.context: the sentence the report puts in quotation marks and attributes to Sheikh al-Dedew
options: God did not take him until he stood alone in the imamate
God did not take his soul until he was without peer in religious leadership
he was not taken by God until he alone held the position of imam
flags.note: This is the one sentence in the record actually attributed to the Sheikh, and it is a strong claim: al-infirād bi-l-imāmah means being left without an equal in scholarly leadership, not holding an office. Option 2 would be read as an office and is wrong. The clause is quoted by the news desk without a source; the site should not present it as a published statement of his until the office confirms where he said it.

flags.arabic: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يؤم المصلين على جنازة فضيلة الإمام الشيخ يوسف القرضاوي
flags.context: the substance of the record: the Sheikh leads the funeral prayer for al-Qaradawi, and is quoted placing him foremost among the inheritors of the Prophet in this age
options: publish as a plain historical record of a funeral prayer
publish with a contextual note on who al-Qaradawi is
withhold pending a decision by Ummah Collective
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW. Yusuf al-Qaradawi is a contested figure: he was barred from entry by the United Kingdom and the United States, and was named as a designated individual by Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Egypt and Bahrain in 2017. This record goes further than record 1133, which reports only a courtesy visit and is flagged on the same ground: here the Sheikh leads the funeral prayer and is quoted in a superlative estimation of al-Qaradawi — that he alone held the imamate of his age and was the foremost inheritor of the Messenger of God in this time. Published in English without context, that endorsement, not merely the attendance, is what carries reputational exposure for the project in Western jurisdictions. The translation is faithful and has been neither softened nor strengthened, and the quoted sentence is itself separately flagged as unsourced. The publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office and must never be taken by default (style guide section 12).

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk, not a text by the Sheikh. Everything asserted here is the desk's, except the sentence it places in quotation marks.
جامع is 'congregational mosque' throughout, as against مسجد 'mosque'; the distinction is live in these reports because the sites named are different buildings.

The report was filed just after midnight on 28 September about an event of the evening of the 27th, so 'this evening' in the body refers to the previous calendar day. The Arabic wording has been kept and not silently corrected.

Raised for editorial review on the same ground as record 1133, and for the additional reason that the quoted estimation of al-Qaradawi is far stronger than the courtesy-visit report in 1133. Faithfulness is in the file; the publication decision is not the translator's.
dec: Beyond reporting a funeral, carries a superlative endorsement of a figure barred from entry by the UK and the US and designated by four Gulf states.
